integrity: Exact algebraic proof with standalone rational-arithmetic witness checker. The numerical prevalence approximations are not proof inputs.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional deterministic mean-field SIS; no global basin classification, finite-population interpretation, or empirical parameter inference. A full-text comparison with a relevant 2026 preprint remains incomplete.
title: Sharp four-endemic-equilibrium bound and two endemic attractors in a purely triadic SIS model
